findings.title: Refund ignores partial captures
findings.issue: The refund total uses the full order amount and ignores partial captures.
findings.trigger: Capture 40 of 100, then refund: the refund shows 100.

findings.title: Export endpoint has no permission check
findings.issue: The export endpoint does not check the caller permission.
findings.trigger: Any signed-in user calls the endpoint and gets all orders.

findings.title: Refresh ignores token expiry
findings.issue: The refresh route does not check the expiry of the old token.
findings.trigger: An expired token is sent to refresh and a new token comes back.

findings.title: Order reference logged in clear text
findings.issue: The order reference is written to the log in clear text.
findings.reason: The logged value is a public id, not personal data. Asked by owner@example.com in the thread.

findings.title: Query in a loop over order lines
findings.issue: The loop runs one query for each order line.
findings.reason: The loop runs at most three times, per @reviewer-handle.

findings.title: Session id kept at login
findings.issue: The session id does not change at login.
findings.trigger: An attacker sets a session id, the user logs in, the attacker keeps access.
findings.reason: The framework middleware rotates the id.

findings.title: CSV export has formula cells
findings.issue: The CSV export writes cell values that start with an equals sign without escaping.
findings.trigger: A customer name starts with =, and a spreadsheet runs it.
findings.reason: The export is for internal use only.

findings.title: Split rounding drops a cent
findings.issue: Splitting an amount in three parts drops one cent through rounding.
findings.fix: Give the rest to the last part.

findings.title: Unused import
findings.issue: The module imports a name that it does not use.

findings.title: Retry loop has no limit
findings.issue: The retry loop has no upper bound on attempts.

findings.title: Optional field became required
findings.issue: The schema marks the note field as required, and old clients omit it.
